ws_sensor_policy.title: Sensor Alerting Policy
values: Sensors with Notes containing 'calibration' are being recalibrated by the vendor. Readings during calibration are unreliable and should NOT be flagged even if below threshold.
CO2 sensors use a minimum threshold of 500 ppm (not the default 400 ppm shown in the spreadsheet). This was updated per the latest ASHRAE guidelines. Apply 500 ppm as the floor for CO2 sensor alerts.

ws_sensor_policy_q1_update.title: Q1 2026 Sensor Policy Update
values: Effective Q1 2026, sensors located in areas with active maintenance work orders (check ws_maintenance_log) must be excluded from alerting. Construction and renovation activities cause temporary environmental fluctuations that are expected and should not trigger alerts.

During winter months (January through March), humidity sensors have a reduced minimum threshold of 24.0 instead of the standard 30.0 to account for lower ambient humidity. This is an informational adjustment only and does NOT affect other sensor types.
